en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a street scene framed by two round medieval stone gate towers with conical roofs, leading into a historic city street lined with low buildings. A tall church or town‑hall spire rises in the distance. The caption in red German script at the bottom reads "Blick in die Lehmstrasse" and "Reval", and a vertical imprint at the left edge reads the publisher information.
